record.bible_text: But it came to pass, that when Sanballat<WH05571> heard<WH08085><WTH8804> that we builded<WH01129><WTH8802> the wall<WH02346>, he was wroth<WH02734><WTH8799>, and took great<WH07235><WTH8687> indignation<WH03707><WTH8799>, and mocked<WH03932><WTH8686> the Jews<WH03064>.

Now Tobiah<WH02900> the Ammonite<WH05984> <FI>was<Fi> by him<WH0681>, and he said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Even that which they build<WH01129><WTH8802>, if a fox<WH07776> go up<WH05927><WTH8799>, he shall even break down<WH06555><WTH8804> their stone<WH068> wall<WH02346>.

Hear<WH08085><WTH8798>, O our God<WH0430>; for we are despised<WH0939>: and turn<WH07725><WTH8685> their reproach<WH02781> upon their own head<WH07218>, and give<WH05414><WTH8798> them for a prey<WH0961> in the land<WH0776> of captivity<WH07633>: <RF>despised: Heb. despite<Rf>

And cover<WH03680><WTH8762> not their iniquity<WH05771>, and let not their sin<WH02403> be blotted out<WH04229><WTH8735> from before<WH06440> thee: for they have provoked <FI>thee<Fi> to anger<WH03707><WTH8689> before the builders<WH01129><WTH8802>.

So built<WH01129><WTH8799> we the wall<WH02346>; and all the wall<WH02346> was joined together<WH07194><WTH8735> unto the half<WH02677> thereof: for the people<WH05971> had a mind<WH03820> to work<WH06213><WTH8800>.<CM>

But it came to pass, <FI>that<Fi> when Sanballat<WH05571>, and Tobiah<WH02900>, and the Arabians<WH06163>, and the Ammonites<WH05984>, and the Ashdodites<WH0796>, heard<WH08085><WTH8804> that the walls<WH02346> of Jerusalem<WH03389> were made up<WH0724><WH05927><WTH8804>, <FI>and<Fi> that the breaches<WH06555><WTH8803> began<WH02490><WTH8689> to be stopped<WH05640><WTH8736>, then they were very<WH03966> wroth<WH02734><WTH8799>, <RF>were made up: Heb. ascended<Rf>

And conspired<WH07194><WTH8799> all of them together<WH03162> to come<WH0935><WTH8800> <FI>and<Fi> to fight<WH03898><WTH8736> against Jerusalem<WH03389>, and to hinder<WH06213><WTH8800><WH08442> it. <RF>to hinder...: Heb. to make an error to it<Rf>
Nevertheless we made our prayer<WH06419><WTH8691> unto our God<WH0430>, and set<WH05975><WTH8686> a watch<WH04929> against them day<WH03119> and night<WH03915>, because<WH06440> of them.

And Judah<WH03063> said<WH0559><WTH8799>, The strength<WH03581> of the bearers of burdens<WH05449> is decayed<WH03782><WTH8804>, and <FI>there is<Fi> much<WH07235><WTH8687> rubbish<WH06083>; so that we are not able<WH03201><WTH8799> to build<WH01129><WTH8800> the wall<WH02346>.

And our adversaries<WH06862> said<WH0559><WTH8799>, They shall not know<WH03045><WTH8799>, neither see<WH07200><WTH8799>, till we come<WH0935><WTH8799> in the midst<WH08432> among<WH08432> them, and slay<WH02026><WTH8804> them, and cause the work<WH04399> to cease<WH07673><WTH8689>.

And it came to pass, that when the Jews<WH03064> which dwelt<WH03427><WTH8802> by them<WH0681> came<WH0935><WTH8804>, they said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto us ten<WH06235> times<WH06471>, From all places<WH04725> whence ye shall return<WH07725><WTH8799> unto us <FI>they will be upon you<Fi> . <RF>From all...: or, That from all places ye must return to us<Rf>

And it came to pass, when our enemies<WH0341><WTH8802> heard<WH08085><WTH8804> that it was known<WH03045><WTH8738> unto us, and God<WH0430> had brought<WH06565><WH00> their counsel<WH06098> to nought<WH06565><WTH8686>, that we returned<WH07725><WTH8799> all of us to the wall<WH02346>, every one<WH0376> unto his work<WH04399>.<CM>

And it came to pass from that time<WH03117> forth, <FI>that<Fi> the half<WH02677> of my servants<WH05288> wrought<WH06213><WTH8802> in the work<WH04399>, and the other half<WH02677> of them held<WH02388><WTH8688> both the spears<WH07420>, the shields<WH04043>, and the bows<WH07198>, and the habergeons<WH08302>; and the rulers<WH08269> <FI>were<Fi> behind<WH0310> all the house<WH01004> of Judah<WH03063>.

They which builded<WH01129><WTH8802> on the wall<WH02346>, and they that bare<WH05375><WTH8802> burdens<WH05447>, with those that laded<WH06006><WTH8802>, <FI>every one<Fi> with one<WH0259> of his hands<WH03027> wrought<WH06213><WTH8802> in the work<WH04399>, and with the other<WH0259> <FI>hand<Fi> held<WH02388><WTH8688> a weapon<WH07973>.

For the builders<WH01129><WTH8802>, every one<WH0376> had his sword<WH02719> girded<WH0631><WTH8803> by his side<WH04975>, and <FI>so<Fi> builded<WH01129><WTH8802>. And he that sounded<WH08628><WTH8802> the trumpet<WH07782> <FI>was<Fi> by me<WH0681>. <RF>by his side: Heb. on his loins<Rf>

And I said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto the nobles<WH02715>, and to the rulers<WH05461>, and to the rest<WH03499> of the people<WH05971>, The work<WH04399> <FI>is<Fi> great<WH07235><WTH8687> and large<WH07342>, and we are separated<WH06504><WTH8737> upon the wall<WH02346>, one<WH0376> far from<WH07350> another<WH0251>.

In what place<WH04725> <FI>therefore<Fi> ye hear<WH08085><WTH8799> the sound<WH06963> of the trumpet<WH07782>, resort<WH06908><WTH8735> ye thither unto us: our God<WH0430> shall fight<WH03898><WTH8735> for us.

So we laboured<WH06213><WTH8802> in the work<WH04399>: and half<WH02677> of them held<WH02388><WTH8688> the spears<WH07420> from the rising<WH05927><WTH8800> of the morning<WH07837> till the stars<WH03556> appeared<WH03318><WTH8800>.

Likewise at the same time<WH06256> said<WH0559><WTH8804> I unto the people<WH05971>, Let every one<WH0376> with his servant<WH05288> lodge<WH03885><WTH8799> within<WH08432> Jerusalem<WH03389>, that in the night<WH03915> they may be a guard<WH04929> to us, and labour<WH04399> on the day<WH03117>.

So neither I, nor my brethren<WH0251>, nor my servants<WH05288>, nor the men<WH0582> of the guard<WH04929> which followed<WH0310> me, none of us<WH0587> put off<WH06584><WTH8802> our clothes<WH0899>, <FI>saving that<Fi> every one<WH0376> put them off<WH07973> for washing<WH04325>. <RF>saving...: or, every one went with his weapon for water<Rf><CM>
